project_info.color_palette: olive green, black, warm tungsten, red-carpet red and neutral skin tones

main_subject.detail: Use the uploaded image as the sole visual reference for an approved adult character; preserve identity, face, age, gender, body proportions, clothing and overall appearance. Do not reproduce any public-figure likeness without authorization.

composition_elements.layout: one 3x2 grid containing six numbered frames, left to right and top to bottom
items: one continuous location and logical time progression

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: lighting matched to source image and held consistently across all six frames
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: continuous scene logic, cinematic depth of field, coherent color grade and narrative movement

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame cinema camera, 50mm base lens with 35mm/85mm coverage, professional storyboard photography
technical_specs.optics: realistic lens continuity, controlled depth of field and no facial distortion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded photograph as the only visual reference. Preserve the approved adult person's identity with maximum accuracy: face, facial features, age, gender, body proportions, clothing and overall appearance must remain unchanged. Do not invent anything that does not exist in the original image. First analyze who is in the image, number and position of people, pose, gaze, facial expression, emotion, clothing, accessories, lighting, time, color temperature, environment, background, depth and emotional tone. Then create one realistic cinematic 3x2 storyboard grid containing six numbered frames left to right and top to bottom. Keep one consistent adult character and environment with logical continuity; each frame differs by pose, camera angle or camera distance and feels like time is passing. Frame 1 is a wide establishing shot; frame 2 medium and closer; frame 3 low or side angle for drama; frame 4 close-up on face, eyes and emotion; frame 5 dynamic diagonal or camera-movement angle; frame 6 calm reflective final shot. Keep lighting, depth of field, color grading and identity consistent across the continuous scene. No facial distortion, no appearance change and no illustration style.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness without authorization, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, inconsistent identity, mismatched lighting, duplicated frames, unreadable frame numbers
